hypotheses.content: Extended, acceptor-rich, or multi-carbonyl aromatic scaffolds can show abrupt scaffold-specific tail onset as PE/EA becomes stronger; intermediate condition points are needed before transferring a high-condition correction.
hypotheses.why_it_matters_for_model_learning: The model needs threshold-sensitive structure-condition features rather than a single global solvent-strength slope.
hypotheses.next_discriminating_question: Do the stronger m114, m122, and m95 points show a transferable tail or scaffold-specific onset?

hypotheses.content: Mobile-phase composition and loading interact nonlinearly, with V2 often changing independently of V1; paired local curves are more informative than isolated extremes.
hypotheses.why_it_matters_for_model_learning: Endpoint-specific condition and loading interactions are a major source of transferable V1/V2 error reduction.
hypotheses.next_discriminating_question: Do the paired m168 and m97 measurements show reproducible endpoint-specific composition or loading slopes?

hypotheses.content: Strong dipolar, oxidized-sulfur, nitrile-amine, and related polar contexts can behave very differently from simple halogenated or nonpolar controls, so structural class and oxidation-state transfer must remain local.
hypotheses.why_it_matters_for_model_learning: It prevents rare polar-scaffold corrections from spreading into the larger compact-control population.
hypotheses.next_discriminating_question: Do the new polar and nitrile-containing candidates retain class-local behavior relative to the halogenated controls?

hypotheses.content: Many weakly interacting, halogenated, and nonpolar controls remain compact even under strong composition, while selected carbonyl or polar contexts are exceptions.
hypotheses.why_it_matters_for_model_learning: Compact controls provide the negative class needed to constrain overcorrection of V1 and V2 tails.
hypotheses.next_discriminating_question: Do the new heavy-halogen and nonpolar controls remain compact at moderate and strong composition?

feedback_interpretation: Recent feedback weakened broad tail inflation: m208 0b8c6c59ae5e24b420e5 and m95 f402144b8672dd5ab2ab were overpredicted, while controls such as 3b45c013164f91745fd2, eb4799360e268e3bbc88, 31d68872f0906ed4c5b1, and 120a3bece2efacad82a7 were near compact behavior. The m12 pair showed strong V2 underprediction at 2/1 in c8f65df578125328ba0e but closer behavior at 10/1 in fefdeb43fb4d634b7880. The m42 pair 375a089de5f20f078dc0 and 1f95ba6922e8753bf2d6 showed V1 underprediction with V2 overprediction. I therefore prioritized local response curves, loading contrasts, and negative controls around known tail families instead of applying a uniform correction.
batch_rationale: The batch contains several meaningful local curves: m168 is paired across loading at the same strong composition, m97 is paired across composition, and m95 supplies lower and higher condition points. The remaining candidates cover ordinary carbonyl and ester interpolation, polar and acceptor-rich tail hypotheses, EA condition coverage, and multiple heavy-halogen or nonpolar controls. This combination repairs large observed failure regions while limiting overcorrection, helping QGeoGNN learn which structure-condition relationships generalize across the Row-distribution.
